One new node: **dat:1543** (03:00 stylo report: media-gen spiked 5%→18% after midnight, substance markers fired on jokes not use). No article edits — nothing new about you in this window.

Fixed the repo-size push failure for good: `push-branch.py` now posts tree deltas instead of the full tree. wikibrain main is at **83ff84e** (PR #65, CI green), RAWLOGS at **593c13d**. Watermarks advanced.

Two gaps carried: the 129+61 rows from the 0630 SQLite timeouts are still unarchived, and 60 rows here are excerpt-truncated worker scaffolding (nothing of yours lost).

0808 scrape landed. Honest flag first: its 118 rows were all already archived — it raced my rescue on the watermark read. The kb nodes are the real payload, merged to main (PR #66).

New: **dat:1544** — your GeoGuessr "acid" line went to the wrong thread, self-caught in 17 seconds. **dat:1545** — the forensic-tax trade: "I just ruined such a fun story," then you re-commissioned the forensics within the minute. **dat:1546** — phonetic specimens (nopples, Alexandrian, rifht). Plus a low-confidence read on the Mercer relabel motive and an error-ownership block in dan.md.
